scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @greenroom/web && npm run build --workspace @greenroom/api
scripts.check: npm run gate:integrity && npm run gate:test-build && npm run gate:d1 && npm run gate:evidence
scripts.dev: npm run setup:local && npm run build --workspace @greenroom/web && concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev --workspace @greenroom/api" "npm run dev --workspace @greenroom/web"
scripts.deploy: npm run migrate:remote --workspace @greenroom/api && npm run build --workspace @greenroom/web && npm run deploy --workspace @greenroom/api
scripts.format: biome format --write . && uv run ruff format tools
scripts.format:check: biome format . && uv run ruff format --check tools
scripts.evidence:d1: node tools/record-run.mjs d1 npm run test:d1
scripts.evidence:e2e: node tools/record-run.mjs e2e npm run test:e2e
scripts.evidence:quality: node tools/record-run.mjs quality npm run test:quality
scripts.evidence:test-build: node tools/record-run.mjs test-build npm run test-build:run
scripts.gate:browser: npm run setup:local && npm run build --workspace @greenroom/web && npm run reset && npm run evidence:e2e && npm run evidence:quality
scripts.gate:integrity: npm run gates:check && npm run format:check && npm run context -- check && uv run python -m unittest discover -s tools/tests && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run openapi:check && npm run schema:check
scripts.lint: biome lint . && node tools/check-errors.mjs && uv run ruff check tools
scripts.schema:check: node --test tools/tests/check-schema-drift.test.mjs && node tools/check-schema-drift.mjs && npm run seed:check
